dex.entry: The apex flint-raven: a large, sleek storm-bird whose entire beak has become a solid static-discharge rod that releases a plasma bolt on each strike; the more it attacks, the stronger each blow. Each hit charges it more — a slow build into an unstoppable momentum that rewards not retreating.
